review: Fresh no-hook replay passed 1536 cases through original helper 0x4D3952 and the original wait helper. The fixture checks the disable path, already-enabled path, and immediate-ready enable path using a controlled peripheral RAM image. It verifies the full peripheral page, local RAM outside the 32-byte stack exclusion, R1 behavior, preserved registers, SP/PC/PRIMASK, and unchanged flash.
limitations: Delayed readiness and timeout paths are not tested; no physical MMIO/timing claim.
No general alias, fault, or concurrency coverage.
Partial/unaccepted; no admission or gate promotion.
